data.one_liner: Dispatch single-time side effects from Bloc or Cubit without polluting state.
data.what_it_does: Provides a mixin for Blocs and Cubits to emit one-shot presentation events alongside widgets to listen to them. Prevents side effects like navigation or snackbars from cluttering the persistent UI state.
use_when: You need to show snackbars, dialogs, or toasts after an action
You need to trigger navigation routes from a Bloc or Cubit
You want to fire fire-and-forget side effects without modifying app state
avoid_when: You are not using flutter_bloc or bloc in your architecture
The event needs to persist across configuration changes or rebuilds as part of the app state
strengths: Keeps UI side effects separate from the core bloc state
Includes a listener widget and works well with flutter_hooks
Supports nullable types for optional blocs in the widget tree
weaknesses: Relies on stream subscriptions which require careful lifecycle handling if not using provided widgets
Requires using a specific mixin on your Blocs/Cubits
